source: Yamaguchi S, Sato S, Toriya M, Tsuji A. Jpn J Antibiot 1999;52(1):41-56, doi:10.11553/antibiotics1968b.52.41 (J-Stage, open access)
source_pdf_location: docs/article_pdfs/52_41.pdf (gitignored; this project ships no source PDFs)

figure3_calibration.method: plot frame = 10^4 (top) and 1 (bottom) ng/mL; decade gridlines at 10, 100 and 1000 confirm the log scale
figure3_calibration.bar_reading: Bars located from their vertical outlines near the baseline; each value read at the midline of the bar's top outline, then 10^((y_bottom - y)/px_per_decade). All 48 bars overlaid on the straightened page and checked.

figure2_calibration.method: axes from the axis lines and inward ticks (0-10 log10 CFU/mL; 0, 2, 4, 6 h)
figure2_calibration.marker_reading: Read from 3x zoomed strips with a 0.1-log10 grid at each sampling time; identities by line style (dotted 1/4 MIC, solid 1 MIC, dashed 4 MIC; filled circles control). Coinciding markers flagged overlap_flagged; markers on the axis floor flagged at_axis_floor.

checks_against_published_values.quantity: ceftazidime 1x MIC free LPS at 4 h
piperacillin 1x MIC free LPS at 4 h
isepamicin 1x MIC free LPS, mean of 2, 4 and 6 h

not_digitized: Figures 4-7 (the pharmacokinetic autosimulation arms) and the electron micrographs.
reading_allowance: Bar values: about 1% (scan resolution 219 px per decade). Viable counts: +/-0.1 log10; overlapping markers are uncertain to the overlap.
